summary: The Network Information Center announces that it is compiling a list of reports from ARPANET sites that matter to participants. This includes reports from ARPA information processing contracts, project hardware and software, and general site reports. Sites were asked to help identify and supply them.

eli5.summary: A library says it wants to collect every report written by the groups on the network. They ask sites to tell them what exists and send copies.

questions: what site reports did the nic collect
why did the nic compile a list of reports
